title: uniprotptmpy: A Python library for the UniProt PTM controlled vocabulary
description: uniprotptmpy is a typed Python package for parsing and querying the UniProt post-translational modification (PTM) controlled vocabulary list. It parses the UniProt PTM list into structured PtmEntry objects covering feature types, taxonomic ranges, and cross-references, and exposes a queryable in-memory database with TSV export and a round-trip writer. An optional FastAPI and Model Context Protocol server exposes the same database over HTTP for interactive lookups and integration with proteomics tooling. uniprotptmpy is intended for proteomics software, annotation pipelines, and research scripts that need programmatic access to UniProt PTM terms. It requires Python 3.12 or later.
